summary.text: Claudia Kauffman is a Democratic member of the Washington State Senate representing District 47, where she took office on January 9, 2023, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Kristina Soltys.

paragraphs.text: Claudia Kauffman lives in Kent, Washington, and earned an associate degree from Northwest Indian College.
Her career experience includes working as the intergovernmental affairs liaison for the Muckleshoot Indian Tribe, overseeing the tribe's legislative agenda at the local, state and federal levels.

Kauffman previously served in the Washington State Senate for District 47 from 2007 to 2011, with committee assignments in 2009-2010 that included Early Learning & K-12 Education, Human Services & Corrections, Rules and Transportation.
She returned to the Senate in January 2023 and, for 2023-2024, was vice chair of the Human Services Committee and a member of the State Government and Tribal Affairs and Transportation committees.
